name: Decorated Farmhouses of Hälsingland
description: In the forested east of Sweden, seven timber farmhouses in Hälsingland show how rich 19th-century independent farmers lived. Their homes are big and solidly built, and the rooms kept for celebrations are covered in painted decoration. Travelling artists blended folk art with the Baroque and Rococo styles of the gentry, and the result looks like a country manor in wood.
